title: Maintenance and spare parts
summary: Technical maintenance, repairs, and spare parts in cooperation with “Klimata serviss”.
paragraphs: BasicAir provides service and maintenance for its clients in cooperation with the company “Klimata serviss”.
Service work includes technical inspection, adjustment, and repair when needed. Maintenance is carried out according to manufacturer recommendations and schedules agreed with the client.

To extend equipment lifespan, damage should be fixed promptly and maintenance performed on time. Installation specialists will advise you on correct operation and the technical solutions that suit you best.
